title: Bind FR-01.11's 27 unbound ACs to existing tests; fix AC-coverage manifest scan gap
context: 27 FR-01.11 ACs (AC01-16,19-29) had no @pytest.mark.covers binding. t0's seam survey named 2 test roots (plugins/shipwright-iterate/tests, shared/tests); AC08/AC09's real implementation lives only in a 3rd, already-canonical ADR-044 root (shared/scripts/tools/tests).
decision: Tagged 25 of 27 unbound ACs onto existing tests in t0's 2 stated roots. Accepted a 3rd-root deviation for AC08/AC09 (real seam is shared/scripts/tools/tests, a canonical ADR-044 root) -- recorded as Exception 3 in the seam survey per t0's own recommendation for this fan-out shape. Widened traceability.test_roots to the full ADR-044 list, which let the manifest regen see AC08/AC09's tags at all. Wrote 2 new tests only where none existed (AC20, AC22). Full detail: --spec-ref.
consequences: unbound 259->232 (exactly the 27 target ACs); zero new orphans. Bumped test_record_event.py's ADR-092 exception 501->507 (4 unavoidable decorator lines). Split test_surface_verification.py's 2 new tests into a sibling file instead of bumping it (no ADR, honest Ousterhout argument impossible for a flat test file). Added test_traceability_config_roots_parity.py so this config gap can't reopen. Fixed a sbom/dashboard mismatch via `uv sync --extra dev`. Full detail: --spec-ref.
rationale: Cites t0's own recommendation ('accept the deviation... forced by where the behavior lives, not chosen') for exactly this shape; precedent already exists for FR-01.20 (3 roots) and FR-01.14 (2 roots incl. this same 3rd root).
rejected: Skipping AC08/AC09 (spec forbids leaving an AC unbound without a recorded reason, and a real seam DOES exist); duplicating AC08/AC09's behavior into shared/tests as a new harness (violates 'no new harness where one fits').
